work.title: The Little Mermaid
work.note: The Little Mermaid, no original "Den lille Havfrue", é um conto de fadas do dinamarquês Hans Christian Andersen, publicado em 1837. Uma jovem sereia vive no fundo do mar e sonha com o mundo dos humanos. Ao se encantar por um príncipe, ela se dispõe a abrir mão de muito para ficar perto dele, e o conto mostra o preço dessa escolha. A cena transforma a referência em prática linguística: “perguntar e dizer a idade com H

facts.big: How old are you? / My birthday is in…
facts.label: Falar de idade e aniversário
facts.sub: Em inglês a idade usa o verbo to be: I'm thirty. Perguntar a idade de adultos pode ser pessoal; entre amigos, costuma ser natural.

facts.sub: In the USA, birthdays are a big deal, but asking an adult “How old are you?” can feel private. Learn when the question is polite.

facts.label: Educação e tom
facts.sub: Say “Happy birthday!” with a smile, and add “Many happy returns!”, which sounds more British. In the USA, a simple wish is perfect.

pages.title: Thirty, thirty-one and a mermaid · 1/3
paragraphs: Today is my friend Omar’s birthday. He lives in Houston, Texas. “**I’m twenty-five!**” he said last year. This year, he is **thirty**. “**Happy birthday!**” I said.

My birthday is in June, so I am turning **thirty-one**. “**How old are you?**” Omar asked me. “**I’m thirty. My birthday is in June**,” I said. He said, “**Happy early birthday!**” It was funny, because it was still May.
pages.prompt: Onde começa e o que acontece?

pages.title: Thirty, thirty-one and a mermaid · 2/3
paragraphs: Omar has a young sister. “**How old is** your sister?” I asked. “**She’s fifteen**,” he said. “She is young!” We looked at her photo. She **looks like** her mother.
At the party, we ate a big cake and sang. Omar blew out the candles and made a wish. Houston is a big city and the home of NASA, so Omar said, “My wish is to go to space!”

pages.title: Thirty, thirty-one and a mermaid · 3/3
paragraphs: On the way home, I thought of an old story. In 1837, the Danish writer Hans Christian Andersen wrote “The Little Mermaid”. The mermaid is **fifteen** in the story. She lives in the sea and dreams of the human world. In Copenhagen, there is a small statue of her by the water. Fifteen is young, but she has a big dream. I think a birthday is a good day to make one.

pages.title: Som e ritmo
pairs: Em -teen a força cai no fim: thir-TEEN, com o som longo.
Em -ty a força cai no começo: THIR-ty, e o final fica curto.
